<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title. Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore. -->

## Motivation

Some deployments must never sample a fixed set of token ids: multimodal placeholder tokens, or padded vocabulary rows past the tokenizer. Sampling and every returned logprob then have to be normalized over the remaining ids, for example to match a downstream consumer that masks the same ids.

Today the only server-side tool is a per-request custom logit processor (`DisallowedTokensLogitsProcessor`). It needs `--enable-custom-logit-processor`, runs per request, and does not reach speculative decoding: the draft keeps proposing banned tokens and the verify step does not see the mask.

## Modifications

- New server arg `--sampling-banned-token-ids <id> [<id> ...]` (`ExecFeatures.sampling_banned_token_ids`), documented in `server_arguments.mdx`. Off by default. `validate_sampling_banned_token_ids` rejects negative ids at startup; ids past the model's vocabulary are ignored with a warning.
- `LogitsProcessor.set_banned_token_ids` records the logits columns of the banned ids (optionally through a column -> token id map). `_get_logits` sets those columns to the dtype's lowest finite value on both of its return paths, with `index_fill_` on a static index, so CUDA graphs capture it. Every consumer reads these logits: sampling, the speculative verify (a drafted banned token gets target probability 0, so it is rejected and never resampled), draft proposals, and every returned logprob, which is normalized over the remaining ids. The fill is finite, so a banned id inside a prompt or used as a scoring label gets the lowest finite logprob rather than `-inf`.
- Target: `ModelRunner.maybe_set_banned_token_ids` masks every `LogitsProcessor` of the target model after load.
- Drafts: `EagleDraftWorkerBase.set_banned_token_ids` masks the draft after its head is set up. It is called by the EAGLE / EAGLE3 / NEXTN draft worker (columns mapped through the hot-token map: EAGLE3 `d2t` or `--speculative-token-map`), the STANDALONE draft worker and the multi-layer EAGLE draft worker. Other drafts (frozen-KV MTP, DFLASH, DSPARK, n-gram) are not masked; their banned proposals are still always rejected by the masked target.
- `DFlashWorkerV2` does not defer its target-verify TP gather while a ban is set, since a vocabulary shard cannot be masked (not run on GPU).
- Tests:
  - `test/registered/unit/layers/test_logits_banned_token_ids.py` (CPU): column selection for full and hot-token-mapped heads; `_get_logits` masks on both its regular and fused-gather return paths.
  - `test/registered/sampling/test_banned_token_ids.py` (`extra-a`, `1-gpu-small`): a positive control on its own server (without the flag, each prompt's greedy continuation starts with a banned id), then no banned id in the output or the top-20 logprobs, greedy and sampled.
  - `test/registered/sampling/test_banned_token_ids_eagle3.py` (`extra-a`, `1-gpu-small`): the same checks with EAGLE3.

## Accuracy Tests

1x GB300, `Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B` + EAGLE3 draft `Tengyunw/qwen3_30b_moe_eagle3` (steps 3, topk 1, draft tokens 4), same GPU and container as the baseline.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Flag unset, `--enable-deterministic-inference`: 24 requests (top-k 5 / 20 / mixed, temperature + seed): output ids, token logprobs, top-20 logprobs | byte-identical to main `8d4e1ce4c7` |
| `--sampling-banned-token-ids 151935` (a padded id that is never sampled), same 24 requests | byte-identical to the flag-unset run, logprobs included |
| `--sampling-banned-token-ids 4236 6303 8697 12095` (" Paris", " five", " blue", " Blue"), prompts whose greedy continuation starts with one of them, greedy and T=1.0, top-20 logprobs, without and with EAGLE3 | 0 banned ids in output ids and in any top-20 row (12 requests); all logprobs finite |
| Columns masked (server log) | target 4 of 151,936; EAGLE3 draft 4 of 32,000 (via `d2t`) |

## Speed Tests and Profiling

`python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random-ids --random-input-len 512 --random-output-len 256 --random-range-ratio 1.0 --num-prompts 320 --max-concurrency 64 --return-logprob --top-logprobs-num 5`, `Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B`, 4 runs per arm (2 server launches x 2 runs), output tok/s, median (min-max):

| | 1x H100 80GB, final head `a9d2637430` | 1x GB300, commit `30fcfa03d5` |
|---|---|---|
| main `8d4e1ce4c7` | 1807.3 (1732.7-1887.7) | 2010.1 (1990.7-2023.7) |
| this PR, flag unset | 1852.6 (1810.7-1891.7) | 2013.2 (2003.8-2031.3) |
| this PR, `--sampling-banned-token-ids` (4 ids) | 1792.5 (1778.5-1833.8) | 2020.9 (2019.6-2026.7) |

H100 launch order: main, flag unset, flag on, flag on, flag unset, main. Commits after `30fcfa03d5` add only the positional field slot and test changes; the masking path is the same. With the flag on, the median is -0.8 % vs main and -3.2 % vs flag unset on H100, and +0.4 % vs flag unset on GB300; in each case the ranges overlap, so there is no overhead outside the run-to-run spread. The mask is one `index_fill_` on a static index per logits call.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). Flag off is byte-identical to main, so no accuracy eval; with the flag on, outputs change only by excluding the banned ids. Overhead measured above.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).


Prepared with the help of Claude Code; every result above was measured as described.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    def set_banned_token_ids(
+        self,
+        token_ids: List[int],
+        device: torch.device,
+        column_token_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Set the logits of token_ids to the lowest finite value in every row
+        from now on, so their probability is 0 and every logprob stays finite.
+
+        column_token_ids maps each logits column to its token id, for a head

+        ids = torch.tensor(sorted(set(token_ids)), dtype=torch.int64)

+                    "Banned token ids >= the vocabulary size %d are ignored.",
+                    self.vocab_size,

+"""--sampling-banned-token-ids: the banned ids never appear in the output or
+in the returned top logprobs. The EAGLE3 case is in
+test_banned_token_ids_eagle3.py."""
+
+import unittest
+
+import requests
+
+from sglang.srt.utils import kill_process_tree
+from sglang.srt.utils.hf_transformers.tokenizer import get_tokenizer
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+    DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+    CustomTestCase,
+    popen_launch_server,
+)
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=150, stage="extra-a", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+# Each prompt's greedy continuation starts with one of the banned words.
+PROMPTS = [
+    "The capital of France is",
+    "One, two, three, four,",
+]
+BANNED_WORDS = [" Paris", " five"]
+
+
+def banned_ids(model):
+    tokenizer = get_tokenizer(model)
+    ids = set()
+    for word in BANNED_WORDS:
+        ids.update(tokenizer.encode(word, add_special_tokens=False))
+    return sorted(ids)
+
+
+class TestBannedTokenIds(CustomTestCase):
+    model = DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST
+    extra_args = []
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.banned = banned_ids(cls.model)
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model,
+            DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            other_args=["--sampling-banned-token-ids", *map(str, cls.banned)]
+            + cls.extra_args,
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def _generate(self, text, temperature):
+        resp = requests.post(
+            f"{DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST}/generate",
+            json={
+                "text": text,
+                "sampling_params": {
+                    "temperature": temperature,
+                    "max_new_tokens": 16,
+                },
+                "return_logprob": True,
+                "top_logprobs_num": 20,
+            },
+            timeout=120,
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200, resp.text)
+        return resp.json()
+
+    def _check(self, temperature):
+        banned = set(self.banned)
+        for text in PROMPTS:
+            out = self._generate(text, temperature)
+            meta = out["meta_info"]
+            self.assertFalse(banned & set(out["output_ids"]), out)
+            for row in meta["output_top_logprobs"]:
+                self.assertFalse(banned & {token_id for _, token_id, _ in row}, row)
+
+    def test_greedy(self):
+        self._check(temperature=0)
+
+    def test_sampling(self):
+        self._check(temperature=1.0)
+
+
+class TestBannedWordsAreTheGreedyContinuation(CustomTestCase):
+    """Positive control: without the flag, each prompt's greedy continuation
+    starts with a banned id, so the banned-id tests cannot pass vacuously. It
+    needs its own server: the flag is server-wide, so the same server cannot
+    show the unbanned continuation."""
+
+    model = DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.banned = banned_ids(cls.model)
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            cls.model, DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST, timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_greedy_continuation_starts_with_a_banned_id(self):
+        for text in PROMPTS:
+            resp = requests.post(
+                f"{DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST}/generate",
+                json={
+                    "text": text,
+                    "sampling_params": {"temperature": 0, "max_new_tokens": 1},
+                },
+                timeout=120,
+            )
+            self.assertEqual(resp.status_code, 200, resp.text)
+            self.assertIn(resp.json()["output_ids"][0], self.banned, text)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""--sampling-banned-token-ids: LogitsProcessor picks the logits columns of the
+banned ids (full vocabulary or a draft hot-token map) and _get_logits masks
+them on both of its return paths."""
+
+import unittest
+from contextlib import nullcontext
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_LOWEST = torch.finfo(torch.float32).min
+
+
+def _processor(vocab_size):
+    processor = LogitsProcessor.__new__(LogitsProcessor)
+    torch.nn.Module.__init__(processor)
+    processor.vocab_size = vocab_size
+    processor.banned_token_cols = None
+    return processor
+
+
+class TestBannedTokenColumns(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_full_vocabulary_columns(self):
+        processor = _processor(vocab_size=8)
+        processor.set_banned_token_ids(token_ids=[5, 2, 5, 9], device="cpu")
+        self.assertEqual(processor.banned_token_cols.tolist(), [2, 5])
+
+        logits = torch.zeros(3, 8)
+        processor._mask_banned_tokens(logits)
+        self.assertTrue((logits[:, [2, 5]] == _LOWEST).all())
+        self.assertTrue((logits[:, [0, 1, 3, 4, 6, 7]] == 0).all())
+        self.assertTrue(torch.isfinite(torch.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)).all())
+
+    def test_hot_token_map_columns(self):
+        processor = _processor(vocab_size=4)
+        hot_token_id = torch.tensor([7, 2, 30, 11])
+        processor.set_banned_token_ids(
+            token_ids=[11, 30, 40], device="cpu", column_token_ids=hot_token_id
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(processor.banned_token_cols.tolist(), [2, 3])
+
+    def test_no_banned_column_leaves_logits_unchanged(self):
+        processor = _processor(vocab_size=4)
+        processor.set_banned_token_ids(token_ids=[100], device="cpu")
+        self.assertIsNone(processor.banned_token_cols)
+        logits = torch.randn(2, 4)
+        expected = logits.clone()
+        processor._mask_banned_tokens(logits)
+        self.assertTrue(torch.equal(logits, expected))
+
+
+class TestGetLogitsMasksBannedTokens(CustomTestCase):
+    """Both return paths of _get_logits (the fused gather + softcap path and
+    the regular path) apply the mask."""
+
+    def _get_logits(self, fused):
+        processor = _processor(vocab_size=6)
+        processor.set_banned_token_ids(token_ids=[1, 4], device="cpu")
+        raw = torch.zeros(2, 6)
+        processor.logit_scale = None
+        processor.final_logit_softcapping = None
+        processor.defer_verify_gather = False
+        processor.do_tensor_parallel_all_gather = False
+        processor.do_tensor_parallel_all_gather_dp_attn = False
+        processor._gather_dp_attn_hidden_states = lambda h, m: (h, h)
+        processor._compute_lm_head = lambda h, lm_head, bias, out=None: raw.clone()
+        processor._can_gather_softcap_fused = lambda *args: fused
+        processor._gather_softcap_fused = lambda logits, meta, use_buffer: logits
+        processor._scatter_dp_attn_logits = lambda logits, local, meta: logits
+        processor._copy_logits_to_buffer = lambda logits, meta, **kwargs: logits
+        metadata = SimpleNamespace(next_token_logits_buffer=None)
+        forward = SimpleNamespace(scoped=lambda **kwargs: nullcontext())
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.srt.layers.logits_processor.get_forward", return_value=forward
+        ):
+            return processor._get_logits(
+                hidden_states=torch.zeros(2, 3), lm_head=None, logits_metadata=metadata
+            )
+
+    def test_regular_path(self):
+        logits = self._get_logits(fused=False)
+        self.assertTrue((logits[:, [1, 4]] == _LOWEST).all())
+        self.assertTrue((logits[:, [0, 2, 3, 5]] == 0).all())
+
+    def test_fused_gather_path(self):
+        logits = self._get_logits(fused=True)
+        self.assertTrue((logits[:, [1, 4]] == _LOWEST).all())
+        self.assertTrue((logits[:, [0, 2, 3, 5]] == 0).all())
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
